sections.summary: 1. Goal: Generative model for watertight B-reps
sections.notes: The goal of this project is to build a generative model for B-Reps. B-Reps (boundary representations) encode parametric surfaces together with precise topological structure.At inference time -- either unconditionally or conditioned on a text-prompt or a point cloud or an image -- the goal is to sample shapes represented as B-Reps that are compatible with various design, animation, and engineering software.

We witnessed huge process in the last two years in generative models for 3D shapes. These models, conditioned on images or text-prompts, can sample high quality 3D shapes represented as implicit fields or meshes or some custom 3D data structure.
